jess_cs: Heads up — NovaHealth POC: mobile SDK init sees intermittent 401s then a rapid rise in 429s. Onboarded yesterday; failures start ~20-40s after their worker cold starts. Can eng help triage?
omar_eng: Can you paste a minimal failing request + any logs? 401->429 pattern usually means token refresh overlap + preflight duplication.
jess_cs: Minimal request from device warmup: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json
{"model":"rwd-embed-2b","input":"warmup"}
```
They mint ephemeral_jwt every 30s from their auth service. Mobile app spins up multiple warmup threads on cold start. After ~8 warmup hits we see 401s then 60-90s of 429s.
infra-bot: Alert: nova-poc key (client_id:nova-42) 5m 429 rate jump 3% -> 35% at 3321459902. Top endpoint: /v1/embeddings.
nina_se: Quick hypothesis: overlapping refreshes cause some requests to present invalid/empty Authorization header (401). Meanwhile, inbound fanout from cold starts hits our per-key concurrency window and trips soft throttling -> 429 flood. Mobile SDK not caching token per-process exacerbates it.
omar_eng: Mitigation checklist:
- Short-term (customer): implement per-instance token caching for ~75-90s to avoid overlap.
- Add jittered exponential backoff on 401s instead of immediate retry.
- Tune SDK maxParallelRequests to 4 for mobile warmup.
Example Android snippet: 
```java
RedwoodConfig cfg = new RedwoodConfig.Builder()
  .setTokenProvider(cachedProvider) // cache token per process 90s
  .setMaxParallelRequests(4)
  .setAuthRetry(new AuthRetry(3, 250, true))
  .build();
```
jess_cs: Customer logs (anonymized): 
```
[11:05:22] POST /v1/embeddings 401 invalid_token
[11:05:23] POST /v1/embeddings 401 Authorization: missing
[11:05:24] POST /v1/embeddings 429 rate_limit_exceeded
[11:05:25] POST /v1/embeddings 429 rate_limit_exceeded
```
nina_se: If they cannot ship SDK changes immediately, we can temporarily: increase soft concurrency cap for nova-42 by +2 slots and enable a 45s token-grace policy for that key. Ops approval required.
sam_ae: FYI this is a POC with a renewal decision in 6 weeks. If onboarding delays extend >48h we should loop in AE and sales engineering. Need ETA for fixes.
jess_cs: Proposed plan: 1) Share SDK snippets + config to Nova today; 2) Ask them to deploy to their staging channel and run 50 warmup runs; 3) If 429 rate >20% after 30m, request ops temporary cap bump. Call in 90m to review. Action owners: Jess -> customer communication & call; Omar -> patch snippet + failure-mode notes; Nina -> ops escalation text.
